name: idea-intake
description: Frame an implementation idea, resolve the target repository, and choose the issue kind. Ask when the repo or kind is ambiguous. Does not search or file.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Prompt text for a future implementation idea, or a pasted feature-brief.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Optional target repository as owner/name when the checkout is ambiguous.

inputs.name: issue-kind
inputs.description: Optional kind: feature, chore, docs, bug, or spec.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: intake-summary
outputs.description: Framed idea, resolved owner/name, issue kind, and matching form file when one exists.

outputs.name: blocking-questions
outputs.description: Markdown list of blocking questions; empty when repo and kind are resolved.
